about.title: About me | Salim Capital
about.description: The Bridge Between Two Worlds: Global Vision, Local Execution. Said Salim's career between the Middle East and Spain.
about.lead: The Bridge Between Two Worlds: Global Vision, Local Execution.
blocks: Over the last decade, I have had the privilege of working at the epicenter of global financial transformation: the Middle East. In a region where ambition and innovation meet, I have specialized in the digital asset ecosystem, helping high-net-worth investors and family funds navigate cryptocurrency volatility and capitalize on the Blockchain technology revolution.
My career in the Gulf has been not only technical but strategic. I have learned that in the world of high-level finance, trust is the most valuable currency and discretion is the fundamental pillar.

Today, I am moving my base of operations to Spain with a clear vision: to serve as the strategic link between the financial dynamism of the MENA region and the institutional strength of the European Union.

Spain is not just a quality-of-life destination; it is the ideal gateway for foreign capital seeking legal certainty, diversification into real assets and access to the European single market. However, moving digital capital between these two regions presents complex regulatory and tax challenges that require in-depth knowledge of both jurisdictions.

My proposal is simple but powerful: remove the friction. I make sure the transition of your wealth is smooth, legal and optimized. Whether you want to diversify your crypto-asset portfolio into Spanish real estate, optimize your tax burden when relocating your residence or structure cross-border investments, my approach combines the agility of the Web3 world with the rigor of traditional financial advisory.
I do not just manage assets; I design the financial vehicle that allows my clients to operate freely in two of the most influential regions on the planet.

I invite you to discover how we can align your wealth objectives with the opportunities this financial bridge offers. The future of wealth is global, digital and diversified. Let us build that future together.

philosophy.title: Investment philosophy | Salim Capital
philosophy.description: Investment Philosophy: The Value of Trust in the Digital Age. Three unshakeable principles: absolute discretion, technical integrity and alignment of interests.
philosophy.h1: Investment Philosophy: The Value of Trust in the Digital Age.
intro: At the intersection of the dynamism of the Middle East and the strength of the European Union, we have built our practice on a single pillar: trust.

We understand that managing someone's wealth is, in essence, managing their time, their effort and their family's future. That is why our investment philosophy is governed by three unshakeable principles:

principles.p: We recommend nothing we have not audited and fully understood.
We only prosper when our clients prosper.

philosophy.closing: We do not see ourselves as service providers, but as strategic partners. Our success is not measured in percentage returns, but in the confidence with which our clients can look to the future.

experience.title: Experience and track record | Salim Capital
experience.description: Financial strategies for a diverse and sophisticated clientele: Gulf family offices, digital ecosystem pioneers, senior executives and private capital.
experience.intro: Throughout my career, I have had the privilege of designing financial strategies for a diverse and sophisticated clientele. My experience has focused on solving complex challenges of capital mobility and asset optimization for high-impact profiles.

profiles.p: I have advised **members of prominent families and Family Offices in the Gulf region**, focusing on the transition of generational wealth into European assets. My work involved diversifying portfolios concentrated in the regional energy and real estate sectors, moving capital into solid structures in the European Union to ensure the preservation of the family legacy.

profiles.t: Pioneers and Leaders of the Digital Ecosystem
profiles.p: I have worked with **Blockchain protocol founders and digital asset 'early adopters'** with significant wealth. My work focused on the 'landing' of digital capital: transforming the volatility of crypto-asset gains into diversified portfolios of real assets in Spain, always within a strict regulatory compliance framework to avoid legal risks.

I have advised **senior executives and sovereign fund directors** operating at the intersection of the Middle East and the West. The main focus was cross-border financial planning, optimizing the residence-based tax burden and creating investment vehicles that allow fluid mobility between their operational centers in the Gulf and their residence in the EU.

profiles.t: Boutique Investment Groups and Private Capital
profiles.p: I have collaborated with **private investment firms and angel investor groups** interested in the Spanish market. My role was to act as the strategic link, identifying *off-market* investment opportunities in Spain's real estate and business sectors and structuring the entry of capital from the MENA region efficiently.

services.title: Service portfolio | Salim Capital
services.description: Service Portfolio: Global Wealth Solutions. Advanced digital asset management, capital relocation and mobility, and legal and tax protection.

items.p: Design of diversified portfolios based on the client's risk profile. Not trading, but long-term asset management (Hold & Growth).
Implementation of institutional *Staking* and *DeFi* strategies to generate steady cash flows on digital assets.
Implementation of cold storage (*Cold Storage*) and multi-signature (*Multi-sig*) systems to eliminate the risk of hacks or lost keys.
Technical planning to convert digital assets into liquid capital or physical assets in Spain, optimizing transfer times and costs.
Facilitating the acquisition of real estate in Spain using digital wealth as the base, connecting the investor with the right partners.
Design of a structure in which the client keeps the agility of Middle Eastern markets while enjoying the security of the European Union.
Analysis and planning to avoid double taxation and optimize the tax burden when relocating residence or capital to Spain.
Comprehensive advice on the source of funds and compliance with anti-money laundering (AML) and KYC regulations, ensuring that capital enters Spain without legal red flags.
Creation of legal structures (companies, holdings or foundations) to protect wealth and facilitate inheritance within the European legal framework.

faq.title: Frequently asked questions | Salim Capital
faq.description: Security and custody, tax and legality, confidentiality and ethics: answers to our clients' most common questions.

qs.q: Do I have to hand over my private keys or seed phrases for you to manage my portfolio?
qs.a: Absolutely not. The security of your assets is the top priority. We implement **segregated custody** solutions and **multi-signature (Multi-sig)** schemes. This means no transaction can be executed without your explicit authorization. You keep full control of your assets; we provide the strategy and the technical execution.

qs.q: How are my assets protected against cyberattacks or system failures?
qs.a: We use institutional-grade protocols. We recommend and set up the migration of assets to *Cold Wallets* (offline storage) and the use of advanced security hardware. Our approach is to eliminate custody risk on centralized exchanges, moving wealth into an environment where only the owner holds the key.

qs.q: Is it legal to move cryptocurrency capital from the Gulf region to Spain?
qs.a: Yes, it is perfectly legal as long as it is done within the regulatory compliance framework. The challenge is not legality but **traceability**. We specialize in documenting the source of funds and ensuring that the transfer of assets complies with AML (Anti-Money Laundering) and KYC (Know Your Customer) regulations in both the MENA region and the European Union.

qs.q: How do you help me avoid problems with the Spanish Tax Agency (Hacienda)?
qs.a: The key is prevention and planning. We do not improvise; we design a tax strategy before the capital enters Spain. We analyze the impact of Wealth Tax and Income Tax, and coordinate the filing of returns (such as Form 720) to ensure your situation is transparent and optimized, avoiding surprises or penalties.

qs.q: How do you handle the confidentiality of your clients' information?
qs.a: Discretion is not an added value; it is our operating foundation. All our mandates begin with the signing of a strictly binding **Non-Disclosure Agreement (NDA)**. We operate under encrypted communication protocols and a 'zero exposure' policy, guaranteeing that your identity and the volume of your assets remain in absolute anonymity.

qs.q: What happens if my goals change or I decide to end the management relationship?
qs.a: Liquidity and freedom are fundamental. Our collaboration models are designed to be flexible. Because you keep control of your keys and ownership of your assets, the transition or termination of management is immediate and frictionless. Our goal is for you to feel secure, not captive.

privacyPolicy.title: Privacy policy | Salim Capital
privacyPolicy.description: How Salim Capital processes personal data (GDPR).

p: The data you provide in the request form: name, email, phone (optional), tax residence, nationality, preferred contact channel, model of interest, approximate asset volume, other assets, goal, urgency and any message you write.
To handle your request, assess the viability of a professional relationship and, where appropriate, contact you through the channel you chose.
Your consent (Art. 6(1)(a) GDPR) and pre-contractual steps taken at your request (Art. 6(1)(b) GDPR).
Data will be kept for as long as needed to assess your request and, if no professional relationship begins, will be deleted within twelve months at most, unless the law requires otherwise.

Data will not be disclosed to third parties except where required by law. The technical provider that receives the form will process the data on the controller's behalf under the corresponding data processing agreement.
If the technical provider processes data outside the European Economic Area, the safeguards set out in the GDPR will apply.

You may exercise your rights of access, rectification, erasure, objection, restriction of processing and portability, and withdraw your consent, by writing to the contact address above. If you believe your rights have not been respected, you may lodge a complaint with the Spanish Data Protection Agency (aepd.es).
The site is served over HTTPS only, and technical and organizational measures are applied to protect your data.

cookiesPolicy.title: Cookie policy | Salim Capital
cookiesPolicy.description: This site does not use cookies or trackers.

sections.h: This site does not use cookies
p: Salim Capital does not set its own or third-party cookies, does not use analytics tools and does not display advertising.

If you choose a language or a theme (light or dark), your browser stores that choice in its local storage so it is kept on your next visit. This information is not sent to any server and you can delete it at any time from your browser settings.
Fonts are served from this same site, without connections to external services.
If any cookie or analytics tool is added in the future, this policy will be updated and your consent will be requested where required.
